title: Your Rulebook

launchpad.outcome: Assemble MY AGHF RULEBOOK: your model’s rules, your risk, your session and your five non-negotiables.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What will I read before every session?

slides.headline: Write your rules while you’re calm, and read them when you’re not.
slides.line: Everything you felt during this phase, you’ll feel again. Your rulebook is how calm-you helps you in those moments.

slides.headline: You will feel these emotions again and again.
slides.line: Tap each moment below. These are the exact moments your rulebook is written for.

steps.label: After a win
steps.sub: You think, “I’m on fire, so I’ll take one more.”

steps.label: After a loss
steps.sub: You think, “I need that money back right now.”

steps.label: A slow Tuesday
steps.sub: You think, “Any trade will do. Just give me something.”

steps.label: Rent is due
steps.sub: You think, “This trade has to work, no matter what.”

slides.headline: Your rulebook is a letter from calm-you to future you.

cards.label: Calm-you
cards.sub: You write the rules today, before the session.

cards.label: Emotional-you
cards.sub: You read them in the middle of a session.

check.prompt: Which version of you should decide your trading rules?

options.label: Calm-you, before the session starts
options.feedback: Yes. Calm-you can think clearly, so calm-you writes the rules that speak for you when emotional-you can’t.

options.label: Whoever is trading in the moment
options.feedback: In the middle of a session, you’re the one who needs to read the letter, not the one who should be writing it.

slides.title: MY AGHF RULEBOOK
slides.punch: REVIEW MODE: editable. SESSION MODE: read-only. Open it any time from your Academy.

slides.quote: Read it before every session. Out loud, if you have to. 😂

slides.prompt: What are the five non-negotiable rules you will never break?
slides.modelAnswer: My five are the rules I don’t negotiate during a session. They change only in review, with evidence.

takeaways: Your rulebook speaks when you can’t.
remember: A LETTER FROM CALM-YOU TO EMOTIONAL-YOU.
